toolAudit.command: pwd; git rev-parse HEAD; ls -a; find packages -maxdepth 2 -type d | head -70
cat package.json; find packages -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d; find packages/server/src packages/cli/src -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -110; find services -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -35

find packages/core/src -maxdepth 2 -type f ! -name '*.test.*' ! -name '*.md' | sort | head -190; find packages/ai/src -maxdepth 2 -type f ! -name '*.test.*' ! -name '*.md' | head -60; cat packages/core/package.json | head -70; sed -n '1,200p' packages/server/src/handlers/message.ts; sed -n '1,160p' packages/server/src/handlers/session.ts

find packages/core/src/session -maxdepth 2 -type f ! -name '*.md' ! -name '*.test.*' | sort; wc -l packages/core/src/session.ts packages/core/src/session/*.ts; rg -n 'export |const (make|run|prompt|loop|submit)|class |Service|Session[A-Z]' packages/core/src/session.ts | head -100; sed -n '1,160p' packages/core/src/session.ts

wc -l packages/core/src/session/runner/{llm,step,model}.ts packages/core/src/bus.ts; rg -n 'export |drain|while |Session|Tool|step\(|compact|yield\*' packages/core/src/session/runner/llm.ts | head -150; sed -n '1,180p' packages/core/src/session/runner/step.ts; sed -n '1,170p' packages/core/src/bus.ts

rg -n 'project|transaction|publishDurable|dispatch|commit' packages/core/src/bus.ts; rg -n 'export |register|project|layer|Step|Execution|Inbox' packages/core/src/session/projector.ts | tail -65; rg -n 'snapshot|execute|permission|ask|export const node' packages/core/src/tool.ts; rg -n 'session.prompt|session.log|session.resume|session.interrupt|session.wait' packages/server/src/handlers/session.ts; cat packages/core/src/instance/service.ts | head -145; sed -n '1,170p' packages/core/src/session/execution/restart.ts

sed -n '1,180p' packages/core/src/instance.ts; sed -n '1,170p' packages/core/src/location-service-map.ts; sed -n '250,330p' packages/core/src/tool.ts; sed -n '1,170p' packages/core/src/tool/runtime.ts; rg -n 'ask|reply|Deferred|pending|rules|export' packages/core/src/permission.ts | head -70; sed -n '285,320p' packages/server/src/handlers/session.ts; sed -n '590,625p' packages/server/src/handlers/session.ts; sed -n '1,140p' packages/server/src/event-feed.ts

sed -n '1,150p' packages/core/src/session/revert.ts; sed -n '1,125p' packages/core/src/session/diff.ts; rg -n 'export |const .*Tool|register|Subagent|Shell|Read|Write|Edit' packages/core/src/tool/plugin.ts packages/core/src/tool/plugin/index.ts packages/core/src/plugin.ts 2>/dev/null | head -70; sed -n '1,120p' packages/core/src/session/inbox.ts; sed -n '235,338p' packages/core/src/session/runner/llm.ts; sed -n '310,335p' packages/core/src/bus.ts; sed -n '385,435p' packages/core/src/bus.ts; rg -n 'needsContinuation|snapshots.capture|snapshot|Step.Ended' packages/core/src/session/runner/step.ts

sed -n '1,145p' packages/core/src/session/execution/subagent-report.ts; sed -n '1,130p' packages/core/src/session/subagent-completion.ts; sed -n '1,130p' packages/core/src/location-services.ts; sed -n '320,415p' packages/core/src/session/model-request.ts; sed -n '138,178p' packages/core/src/permission.ts
